EmailTemplate.name: Core_CoveredAccount_Notification
EmailTemplate.subject: Lead Reassignment: Lead from Covered Account Assigned to Account Owner
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Lead.OwnerFirstName}, The lead {!Lead.Name} from {!Lead.Company} assigned to you with a lead stage of MAQL, and the Lead Status has not been set to “accepted” or “rejected” within the SLA time for a lead with priority of {!Lead.Core_Lead_Priority__c}. Click here to visit this lead record in SFDC. As a reminder, the following SLA is expected for any MAQL lead assigned to you:
(<Lead Priority> if Hot): Lead Status must be set to “accepted” or “rejected” within 1 business day (<Lead Priority> if Warm): Lead Status must be set to “accepted” or “rejected” within 2 business days (<Lead Priority> if Cold): Lead Status must be set to “accepted” or “rejected” within 4 business days Please disposition your lead by updating the Lead Status ASAP. Any leads not updated will be collected and a list of stagnant leads along with lead owners will be sent to your team lead weekly. Thank you, please refer to this document https://rally1.rallydev.com/(link to resource center) if you have questions regarding how to manage any lead assigned to you or claimed by you.
